name: @osage/kart-client
description: Browser client of the osage kart world (three.js), predicting its kart with the world's physics in WebAssembly

scripts.dev: npm run generate && npm run wasm && vite
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run wasm && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.test: npm run generate && npm run wasm && vitest run
